domain.text: Tooling: make child-process tests resilient to load with measured, per-test timeouts and a capped Vitest worker pool.

impressions.text: The task concerned flaky child-process test timeouts and required measured workload-specific budgets, a CPU-based worker cap, and ten full-suite runs under parallel load.
The worker reported implementing per-test budgets, preserving the global 15-second timeout, adding diagnostic child-process helpers, and documenting timeout and clock practices.
The worker reported ten consecutive loaded runs with 243 tests passing each time and zero failures; its reported cold measurements also showed workload-specific child-process costs.
The worker reported that the required local check chain and CI passed; the delivery record marks the PR merged.
